name: bait-concurrent-cancel-handler
description: Bait control, a backend variant of the second-actor pattern. A Cancel handler that hands the work to the store and maps its errors the way Get beside it does, a refused cancel to 409. The temptation: two cancels race, or the order changes between them. Whether the store's cancel is atomic is in a file not shown; nothing shown makes the race reachable, and the handler maps every outcome. Nothing to report.
